dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior, exhibiting a significant lateral curvature of the peduncle toward the right side of the frame.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical irregularities along the lateral margins, particularly a slight indentation on the left margin (animal's right) posterior to the widest point.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white; high median pixel intensity indicative of a sub-adult or mature individual.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency of diffuse, darker grey patches localized primarily on the anterior dorsal surface and along the lateral flanks.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; low-contrast gradients between the light-grey base and the darker mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Visible fine, longitudinal white linear marks (likely scratches) concentrated along the central dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple fine, healed linear rake marks or scratches along the sagittal plane of the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced lateral axial deviation of the caudal section relative to the primary longitudinal body axis.
